source.note: The reference is the KernelBench problem; the dispatch contract around it is what this tier adds.

target_environment.note: The task names the environment it was measured in and leaves the device model, architecture and component versions in that record. Latencies are comparable only within one snapshot_id.

tensor_contract.note: float16 and bfloat16 only. On the target environment the fused attention path does not answer float32, so a float32 run would silently grade the composition path and call it a dispatch result.

submission.note: KernelBench-style submission: a Python module defining ModelNew. The fused and composition paths call the whitelisted libraries; the fallback may JIT-compile a .mu kernel.

scoring.gate: every hidden correctness case passes and every dispatch trace matches the expected path
scoring.ranking: B-library track only; never merged or averaged with the A-kernel track

admission.measured_over: the private case manifest, which is the set the gate is defined over
admission.reason: the hidden set was measured on the target environment. Both halves of §4.4's gate hold: every hidden case passes correctness, and every dispatch trace names the path the case expects.
admission.dispatch_note: the attention core is a single causal SDPA over (B, H, S, D), which is the shape a fused library answers

gap_reason_coverage.basis: §4.3 asks a task's hidden gap set to cover at least two reason categories; this task reaches one. unsupported_shape: head_dim is n_embd / n_head rather than a free parameter, and the fused path's head-dimension window on the measured build ends at 128, so 192 and 256 leave the flash path. semantic_mismatch is unreachable because the scale is hard-coded to 1/sqrt(D) (the only value the fused path accepts) and there is no window, so every query row sees j <= i and no row can be fully masked. layout_mismatch is unreachable because the contract layout is contiguous BHSD, which the measurement showed still dispatches fused. multi_operator_required is unreachable because the attention core is one SDPA call. Either a second measured category has to be found on the device or this entry needs a wider contract before it can meet the floor.
